contextWindow.value: up to 100K tokens at inference (except Code Llama - Python 70B and Code Llama - Instruct 70B); fine-tuned with up to 16K tokens

source.quote: All models but Code Llama - Python 70B and Code Llama - Instruct 70B were fine-tuned with up to 16K tokens, and support up to 100K tokens at inference time.
Code Llama and its variants are intended for commercial and research use in English and relevant programming languages.
A custom commercial license is available at:
All variants are available in sizes of 7B, 13B, 34B and 70B parameters.

architecture.value: autoregressive language models using optimized transformer architectures; 7B/13B/70B also support infilling

source.quote: Code Llama and its variants are autoregressive language models using optimized transformer architectures. Code Llama 7B, 13B and 70B additionally support infilling text generation.

trainingData.value: same data as Llama 2 with different weights; Instruct adds instruction fine-tuning data

source.quote: All experiments reported here and the released models have been trained and fine-tuned using the same data as Llama 2 with different weights

trainingCompute.value: 1400K GPU hours on A100-80GB for all 12 models; 228.55 tCO2eq (100% offset)

source.quote: In aggregate, training all 12 Code Llama models required 1400K GPU hours of computation on hardware of type A100-80GB (TDP of 350-400W). Estimated total emissions were 228.55 tCO2eq, 100% of which were offset by Meta’s sustainability program.

topics.headline: Instruct variant aimed at safer deployment; outputs may be objectionable; deployers should safety-test

source.quote: the model may in some instances produce inaccurate or objectionable responses to user prompts. Therefore, before deploying any applications of Code Llama, developers should perform safety testing and tuning tailored to their specific applications of the model.

topics.headline: May produce inaccurate responses to user prompts

source.quote: Code Llama’s potential outputs cannot be predicted in advance, and the model may in some instances produce inaccurate or objectionable responses to user prompts.

findings.text: Capability and safety evaluation numbers are not in this model card; the card points to Sections 3 and 4 of the research paper.

source.quote: See evaluations for the main models and detailed ablations in Section 3 and safety evaluations in Section 4 of the research paper.

findings.text: Training all 12 Code Llama models used 1400K A100-80GB GPU hours and about 228.6 tCO2eq, fully offset by Meta.

source.quote: In aggregate, training all 12 Code Llama models required 1400K GPU hours of computation on hardware of type A100-80GB (TDP of 350-400W). Estimated total emissions were 228.55 tCO2eq, 100% of which were offset by Meta’s sustainability program.

findings.text: This is a static offline-trained model; Meta plans further Code Llama - Instruct releases as safety improves with community feedback.

source.quote: This is a static model trained on an offline dataset. Future versions of Code Llama - Instruct will be released  as we improve model safety with community feedback.

findings.text: Safety testing to date was in English only and could not cover all scenarios.

source.quote: Testing conducted to date has been in English, and has not covered, nor could it cover all scenarios.

findings.text: Non-English use is listed as out of scope, along with illegal use and Acceptable Use Policy violations.

source.quote: Use in any manner that violates applicable laws or regulations (including trade compliance laws). Use in languages other than English. Use in any other way that is prohibited by the Acceptable Use Policy and Licensing Agreement for Code Llama and its variants.

notes: Source is the short GitHub MODEL_CARD.md only (seed lists this one document). It has no evaluation tables; numbers are deferred to the research paper Sections 3–4, which was not in the seed card documents so scores were left empty. Model Dates (Jan 2023–Jan 2024) describe training, not a release date. Seed covers are the four Instruct HF ids; base/Python variants are mentioned in the card but map to the same Instruct seed rows via checkpoints. Quote for modalities uses the Input line only (Output is a separate sentence). Special apostrophe in Meta’s must match the file.
